SECTION: FMRCT01 §11 — seed manifest and frozen fork priority
DERIVATION: seed = int(SHA256(MRCI01_tip || FMRCT01 || B1 || KIND || index)[:16],16) mod (2^32 - 1)
FORK_PRIORITY: key = SHA256(tip || FMRCT01 || B1 || PRIORITY || index); eligible blocks are taken in ascending key order until MAX_FULL_FORKS are selected. The order is fixed before the first world and no outcome can enter it.
